Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring a two-thirds vote in order for the legislature to declare an emergency.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to declarations of emergency by the legislature;adding a new section to chapter 44.04 RCW; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: It is the intent of the legislature topreserve the constitutional right of the people to have the power ofreferendum. Recently, this power has been limited due to the overuseof emergency clauses in legislation. The legislature finds that theemergency clause should be reserved for true emergencies rather thanusurping the referendum power of the people.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 44.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: In order for an act to be necessary for the immediate preservationof the public peace, health, or safety, or support of the stategovernment and its existing public institutions, as stated in ArticleII, section 1 of the Washington State Constitution, there must be atwothirds vote of the legislators elected or appointed to each house p. 1 SB 6318of the legislature.
